notes.title: More drops!
notes.notes:
Hey Broccoli Community!

We are thrilled to announce some fantastic new updates after the unfortunate issues that happened on release!

[b]Brand New Drop System[/b]

Now you will recieve a new broccoli every 3 hours, including one immediate drop after you log in the game for the first time! This broccoli can range from being common, to all the way legendary! We posted the drop chances in our [url=https://discord.gg/edQNkrmpPF]DISCORD SERVER[/url]!

Revamped User Interface and Animations

We added some animations to the broccoli when you click it, also slightly revamped the UI for a better experience!

I hope you guys will enjoy the update, and also sorry for the bugs and issues. Love you guyss! Giveaways and news in our discord!

notes.title: Adressing the drop system
notes.notes:
Upon the release of our game, we discovered a significant bug that prevents players from receiving in-game drops, despite them investing countless hours into playing. We have already rolled out an update in an attempt to resolve this problem; however, it appears that the issue persists. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience and want to assure you that our team is diligently working on another update to fix the drop system as soon as possible. We kindly ask for your patience and understanding during this time.


Join our [url=https://discord.gg/edQNkrmpPF]DISCORD SERVER[/url] for updates regarding this issue! We will be giving away A LOT of broccolies once we fixed this issue!

notes.title: FIXED BUGS!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to inform you that the issues with the drop system have now been resolved. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the bugs that were present at the time of release. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this period. Thank you for your continued support.
Join the [url=https://discord.gg/edQNkrmpPF]DISCORD SERVER[/url] for updates and giveaways!

notes.notes:

notes.title: RELEASE BUGS
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that our game has officially launched! However, we have encountered a bug with our drop system that we are actively working to fix. We anticipate having this issue resolved today.

To stay updated on our progress and receive the latest news, we invite you to join our Discord community. Our team will be providing regular updates there, and you can also interact with other players and share your experiences.

Thank you for your understanding and patience as we work to improve your gaming experience. We appreciate your support and are committed to delivering the best possible gameplay.
